summary: Gravel road-end pull-in backed by bush, with a car parked and homes about 21 m off.
reasons: Bush behind, gravel end with parked car

drivers.seclusion: Bush to the north and east; the nearest house is 21 m south of the apron and others are 31 m or more away.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed road runs to a gravel apron at the end; a vehicle is parked there, so a van fits. The earlier part of the line is under bush with no road.
drivers.traffic: Dead end serving a few houses and a track; very little traffic.
drivers.convention: One vehicle parked on the apron; 2P Mon-Fri 9am-5pm sign is daytime only.

flags: Apron is nearly level (about 0.7%); the bush stretch before it falls up to 6.6%
Homes within about 25 m on the south side
Mapped gates about 80-95 m away with ways round them
sun_shade: Bush shades the north and west; open to midday sun from the north-east on the apron.
cannot_judge: Whether the apron is used by residents for turning or parking

best_section.where: Gravel apron at the end of Goldieslie Road where the white vehicle sits
